name: Unfocused Music Effect
description: Music effect when your game is unfocused

volume-multiplier.name: volume multiplier
volume-multiplier.description: What multiplier should be applied to the music's current volume when attempting to suppress? 0 = completely muted, 0.5 = half muted

transition-time.name: fade length
transition-time.description: How long should it take (in milliseconds) to transition into the target volume level? 0 = instant switch

cutoff-multiplier.name: low-pass cutoff multiplier
cutoff-multiplier.description: 22000hz multiplied by this value. Raise the volume multiplier above 0 to hear the effect.
